intro: Pediatric Lab Reference Values is a searchable, browsable reference tool inside PediAid for looking up normal laboratory values relevant to pediatric and neonatal patients. Labs and reference guides are organized by clinical system — including cardiology, endocrinology, fluids & electrolytes, gastroenterology, genetics, hematology, immunology & allergy, microbiology & infectious disease, neonatology, nephrology, nutrition & growth, oncology, poisonings, pulmonology, rheumatology, and trauma & critical care — and users can either browse by system or search directly for a specific lab test or guide. The reference is drawn from the Harriet Lane Handbook, 22nd Edition.
indications: Quickly looking up a normal pediatric lab value at the bedside or during rounds
Comparing a patient's result against age-appropriate pediatric reference ranges rather than adult norms
Browsing labs organized by organ system or specialty, such as hematology, nephrology, or endocrinology
Searching for a specific test or reference guide by name across all systems
Cross-checking values across systems such as fluids & electrolytes, nutrition & growth, and poisonings
method: This is a reference and search tool rather than a calculator. Lab items and guides are grouped into clinical systems, shown as tiles with a count of how many items in that system currently have data; tapping a system opens its list of items, or the search bar can be used to find a specific lab or guide by name across all systems.

faqs.q: What is the source for the pediatric lab reference values?
faqs.a: The tool's own reference footer cites the Harriet Lane Handbook, 22nd Edition.

faqs.q: How are labs organized in this tool?
faqs.a: By clinical system — such as cardiology, hematology, nephrology, neonatology, and endocrinology — which can be browsed as tiles, or searched directly by name.

faqs.q: Can I search for a specific lab test directly?
faqs.a: Yes, the tool includes a search bar for finding labs and guides by name instead of browsing by system.

faqs.q: Does this tool calculate anything, or is it purely a reference?
faqs.a: It is purely a reference and lookup tool — it does not perform any calculations.

faqs.q: Are all listed lab items populated with data?
faqs.a: Not necessarily — the tool marks some items as "Coming Soon" when data has not yet been added for that item, and shows a data-availability count on each system tile.
